result_text:
I changed the two mock-folder rules in `codeanalyzer/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/sourcecode/scoping/ScopingConventions.java` (lines 393–394). I haven't tested the new rule against your example paths, and I added no test for it.

- **Old rule:** `.*/mock[a-zA-Z0-9_\- ]+/.*` and `.*/__mock[a-zA-Z0-9_\- ]+/.*`. These needed at least one ASCII letter, digit, `_`, `-` or space after `mock`, so plain `mock/`, `mock.data/`, `mock(old)/` and `mock-größe/` were missed.
- **New rule:** `.*/mock[^/\\]*/.*` and `.*/__mock[^/\\]*/.*`. Any folder name starting with `mock` or `__mock` now matches, whatever follows. The match stays inside that one folder name.
- **Backslash paths:** `SourceFileFilter.pathMatches` already tries the path with slashes normalised, so Windows-style paths work without further changes.
- **What stays non-test, by reading the regex:** `remock/` and `demo/` don't match because the folder name must start with `mock`. Files named `mock.java` or `mockery.java` don't match because the rule needs a `/` after the folder name. `src/main/java/` doesn't contain `mock`. The old folders (`mocks/`, `__mocks__/`, `mock-data/`, `mock_data/`, `mock data/`, `mockStore/`) still match.

I ran `mvn -q -o test -Dtest='ScopingConventions*'` in `codeanalyzer`. It finished with no output, and I didn't check that any tests actually ran.
